title: Payload 3.25.0 before 3.90.0 and 4.0.0-canary.0 before 4.0.0-canary.34 contains an authorization bypass through a…
description: Payload versions 3.25.0 before 3.90.0 and 4.0.0-canary.0 before 4.0.0-canary.34 have an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw arises from the client upload handling using a user-controlled key that selects the upload collection from the client rather than the server. Authenticated users with upload permissions can exploit this to access files outside their authorized upload collections in deployments using multiple upload collections.
